_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The new-conversation directory chip shows a home-relative path, and a stale directory listing does not overwrite a newer one. On this phone-sized screen "the directory control" is in the overflow menu: when ".chat-overflow-popover" is not visible, first click the header's button with aria-label exactly "More options"; the control is then the button in ".chat-overflow-popover" whose accessible name starts with "Directory". The directory {{HOME}}/exe exists. The picker is ".modal.directory-picker-modal". The server's answer to listing the directory /definitely-missing-shelley-directory is held back: call "requested" says whether that listing request has arrived ("true" or "false"); call "release" lets it answer {"error": "delayed directory error"} and returns once it has. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /new. 2. window.__SHELLEY_INIT__.home_dir should be exactly "{{HOME}}". 3. Set localStorage "shelley_selected_cwd" to "{{HOME}}/exe" and reload by navigating to /new again. 4. The directory control should contain the text "~/exe". 5. Click the directory control. 6. The picker's ".directory-picker-input" should have the value exactly "{{HOME}}/exe/". 7. Click the picker's button named "Go to home directory". 8. The input should have the value exactly "{{HOME}}/" and ".directory-picker-current-path" exactly the text "{{HOME}}". 9. Fill the input with "/definitely-missing-shelley-directory/". 10. Call "requested" until it returns "true". 11. Click "Go to home directory" again. 12. The input should have the value exactly "{{HOME}}/" and ".directory-picker-current-path" exactly the text "{{HOME}}". 13. Call "release". 14. Wait one animation frame (eval a promise that resolves in requestAnimationFrame). 15. There must be no ".directory-picker-error" element (count 0).
